{changes}

## Which file to flash

| File | Pick it to |
| --- | --- |
| `minimalpad_with_studio-v{version}.uf2` | Change your keys with Minimalpad Studio or Minimalpad Configurator |
| `minimalpad-v{version}.uf2` | Keep the keys this firmware sets, without ZMK Studio |

## How to flash

1. Connect the Minimalpad to your computer with a USB cable.
2. Press its reset button twice, quickly. A drive called NICENANO appears.
3. Copy the `.uf2` file onto that drive. The pad restarts with the new firmware.
